business_problem: Genius Sports needed to tame a messy quoting and invoicing process across complex media and data products, where custom objects, fragmented systems, and manual compliance steps were slowing commercial execution.
solution_summary: Genius Sports standardized its opportunity-to-cash stack on Salesforce by moving quoting and invoicing off custom objects and onto RCA and RCB. Those standard objects are connected to job codes, invoice records, and usage data through Data 360, giving the commercial team one revenue model instead of separate quoting, billing, and finance views. On top of that foundation, Genius Sports and its partner Nextview are building an Agentforce quoting agent that lets sellers create renewal and extension quotes in natural language. The agent clones relevant campaign details from prior quotes, updates dates for the new term, and enforces pricing and catalog rules automatically. Sales Cloud then exposes payment status beside the pipeline so sellers can answer billing questions without hunting through other systems, creating a cleaner handoff from quote creation to invoice processing and customer follow-up.

solution_components.name: RCA
solution_components.role: Provides the standardized quoting object model for Genius Sports' commercial workflows.

solution_components.name: RCB
solution_components.role: Handles invoicing and billing records on the same Salesforce revenue foundation.

solution_components.name: Data 360
solution_components.role: Joins quote, invoice, and usage data into a single commercial source of truth.

solution_components.name: Agentforce
solution_components.role: Generates compliant renewal and extension quotes from natural-language seller requests.

solution_components.name: Sales Cloud
solution_components.role: Shows payment status next to pipeline data so sellers can manage accounts with less context switching.

data_flow: Usage data and revenue records are joined in Data 360 alongside RCA and RCB objects. Agentforce then creates or clones compliant quotes from that foundation, invoice records move downstream for billing, and Sales Cloud surfaces payment status back to the commercial team for ongoing account work.
business_outcome: Genius Sports reduced manual quote work, automated most invoicing, improved billing visibility for sellers, and built a more scalable commercial workflow for complex media and data contracts.
metrics: 90 seconds of time savings per quote creation
5% of salesperson time spent on billing inquiries
up to 10 campaign jobs from an old quote
architecture_clues: The quoting agent clones renewal and extension details from earlier quotes.
Role-based access permissions are preserved while custom agents act on revenue data.
Automated invoice records are passed directly into the ERP system.
